function listPosts({url,$}) { const posts=[]; $('item,entry').each((i,e)=>{const x=$(e); const a=x.find('link[rel="alternate"]').first(); const u=a.attr('href')||x.find('link').first().attr('href')||x.find('link').first().text(); if(u && u.includes("/blog/"))posts.push({url:u,title:x.find('title').first().text(),publishedAt:x.find('pubDate,published,updated').first().text()});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const b=$("[class^=\"_md_\"]").first().clone();b.find('script,style,nav,header,footer,aside,.comments,#comments,.related-posts,.post-footer,.post-share').remove();const t=$("h1").first();return {title:t.attr('content')||t.text().trim(),bodyHtml:b.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('[rel="author"]').first().text()||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 實讀渲染文章；公開 feed 限 /blog/ 個人文章，排除獨立書籍目錄。正文為 [class^="_md_"]，排除側欄文章清單；標題 h1。
